decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 6 April 2006, the replacement of existing sash windows with double glazed windows with hardwood frames to the front elevation of the first floor flat, 44C Cambridge Road South, Chiswick, London W4 3DA, as shown on drawing number 1.0 received 6 April, was lawful within the meaning of Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for the following reason:
The proposed development would not materially affect the external appearance of the building and does not constitute development and therefore falls within Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). Planning permission is therefore not required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the replacement of existing sash windows with double glazed windows with hardwood frames to front elevation of first floor flat
